scope: game_runtime F3 codex gamepad category, entry, and filter input
implemented: Runtime F3 codex panel now accepts Bevy gamepad button input in addition to keyboard and pointer input while keeping all codex state inside Runtime UI state
Gamepad LT maps to the same previous-category action as keyboard Q
Gamepad RT maps to the same next-category action as keyboard E
Gamepad D-pad left maps to the same previous-entry action as keyboard B
Gamepad D-pad right maps to the same next-entry action as keyboard N
Gamepad Y/North maps to the same discovered-only filter toggle as keyboard V
The input helper reads GamepadButtonType from ButtonInput<GamepadButton> without binding the UI action to a single physical gamepad id
The F3 helper text exposes keyboard, pointer, and gamepad controls without loading generated story/codex candidate text
The Runtime surface contract now records the gamepad input source-shape alongside existing keyboard and pointer bindings
limitations: This is a text-panel gamepad input prototype, not a complete visual clickable codex layout.
It is covered by source-shape and unit tests, not by a real physical gamepad manual review.
It reads accepted runtime content pack metadata and MetaProgress only; it does not load generated story/codex candidate text.
It does not replace human story review, Runtime UI review, final human acceptance, manual base UI review, Bevy smoke, or release readiness.
